subject: HealthLytics POC kickoff — aligning owners, timeline, and success criteria
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@healthlytics.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Barnes <tom.barnes@healthlytics.com>, sec-requests@healthlytics.com
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: HealthLytics POC — availability and success criteria

Hi Aditya / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the engineering and product teams at HealthLytics want to move forward with a short POC to validate inference latency and data isolation for our PHI pipeline.

Stakeholders to include:
- Product engineering (myself + Tom Barnes)
- Security (sec-requests@healthlytics.com)
- Procurement (Tom will coordinate contracting)
- Our ML infra lead (we'll add name once he confirms)

Primary asks for kickoff:
1) Agree success criteria (latency SLO, cost per 1k tokens, KV cache behavior)
2) Draft timeline + milestones for a 4-week POC
3) Assign owners (SE/AE cust points + HealthLytics owners)

We have availability next week on Tue/Wed mornings PST and Fri afternoon PST. Can you propose a 60–90 minute slot and any prep materials we should review?

I've attached a short one-pager with our internal requirements.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Director of Product
HealthLytics

Attachment: HL-POC-requirements.pdf (1 page)

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@healthlytics.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.inference>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: HealthLytics POC — availability and success criteria

Hi Marta — great to hear, excited to run this with your team.

Thanks for the one-pager; it helps frame the right owners. Proposed plan:
- Kickoff (60–90m): agree success criteria, scope, timeline, and owners
- Security deep-dive (45m): runbook for PHI handling, KMS, audit logs
- Tech setup (30m): credentials, model selection, and basic test harness

Pre-reads: I'll attach our POC template and a short checklist for the security call. Can the ML infra lead share the list of test datasets (sanitized) they'd like us to run?

Immediate availability (all times PDT):
- Tue Apr 20: 9:30–11:00, 14:00–15:30
- Wed Apr 21: 09:00–11:30
- Fri Apr 23: 13:00–16:00

If none of those work, propose two alternate slots and we'll prioritize.

Attaching: Redwood-POC-template.docx

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0147

Attachment: Redwood-POC-template.docx (editable checklist + timeline)

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@healthlytics.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Cc: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.inference>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: HealthLytics POC — availability and success criteria

Thanks Marta — quick note from the AE side on agenda and expected attendees.

Suggested kickoff agenda (60–90m):
- 0–10m: intros + POC objectives (Aditya / Monica)
- 10–30m: architecture + dataflow walkthrough (Ava / HealthLytics infra)
- 30–55m: success criteria discussion and measurement plan (Neha / HealthLytics)
- 55–75m: open Q&A & next steps + milestone owners (Rishi / Procurement)

Please plan to include: the ML infra lead, a security engineer, and whoever owns procurement/contracting on your side.

Also, we've found it helps to run the security deep-dive as a separate, 45m session the same week so we don't squeeze detailed controls into the kickoff. I've attached an updated draft of success criteria that maps to the one-pager Marta sent.

Attachments: POC-success-criteria-v2.docx

If possible, can HealthLytics confirm procurement contact for contracting and preferred NDA scope?

— Monica
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.inference | +1 212-555-0199

From: Tom Barnes <tom.barnes@healthlytics.com>

Forwarding the original note below for context. I can also add a procurement contact spreadsheet to the thread.

Thanks,
Tom Barnes
